datasetDefinitions.storageRationale: Keep the audited DAY/WAL/DEDUP layout and (symbol,batch_id,trade_date_ts) UPSERT KEY. The business identity is (trade_date,symbol,batch_id), represented by the one-to-one trade_date_ts calendar carrier plus symbol and batch_id; the highest batch_id per symbol/day is the Python consumer selection rule, while every source batch remains stored. The physical timestamp is a UTC-midnight carrier derived from the calendar date.
